reviewer.role: Independent source owner, crop, context, focus, and default reviewer

repository.scope: The three named matrix catalog owners and their one DMG page-74 source region each. This is not a whole-book, whole-site, all-owner, or field-mapping completeness review.

source.mapping: DMG printed p. 74 maps to supplied PDF p. 75.

renderFrame.coordinates: PyMuPDF default CropBox; page.rect coordinates, CropBox-relative top-left origin

method.inspection: Inspected the current v4 rendered crops and focus overlays against the supplied DMG p. 74 / PDF p. 75 source pixels. Reviewed actual text/ink and table boundaries, not just coordinate containment or OCR. The I.C qualifier and the I.D.1 superscript/note markers were checked in the displayed overlays.
separations: Crop completeness, contextual adequacy, focus relevance/precision, and default selection were reviewed as distinct dimensions.
The existing independent 378-cell transcription comparison is separate evidence. This review does not regrade the transcribed cell values or bind individual fields to cells.
The DMG Monk/PHB Monk disagreement remains an unresolved source conflict; this review makes no ruling between the printings.

browserVerification.siteUnderTest: Current dist/ static build served locally from the evaluated worktree.

productionLinkGenerator.verification: Generated each link from buildVisualCoverage output, then loaded the exact generated hash route in Chromium against the current dist build. Confirmed the matrix owner title, DMG p. 74 page selection, requested region id, matching image filename, and zero page errors.

monkConflictNavigation.path: From the I.A matrix conflict link, opened the Monk class guide; confirmed the visible PHB p. 30 versus DMG p. 74 conflict note; clicked the PHB source group, selected PHB p. 30, and confirmed the existing PHB region image loaded.
monkConflictNavigation.limitation: This checks existing guide navigation only. It is not a new PHB crop review, does not establish the PHB table's mechanics, and does not resolve the source conflict.

reviewedOwners.title: Attack Matrix for Clerics, Druids and Monks

sourceContentObserved.table: I.A. ATTACK MATRIX FOR CLERICS, DRUIDS AND MONKS; opponent AC −10 through 10, seven attacker-level bands (1–3, 4–6, 7–9, 10–12, 13–15, 16–18, 19+), 147 numeric cells.
sourceContentObserved.note: Missiles: −5 at long range, −2 at medium range.
sourceContentObserved.pixelFinding: Heading, table axes, all rows/cells, and the full missile adjustment line are visible. The focus marks the entire named lookup table and its distinct note; no printed glyph is clipped.

crop.evidence: Inspected the current crop against DMG PDF p. 75 pixels. It contains the entire named I.A table, heading and attached missile note; the table and note remain inside the rendered bounds with no clipped glyph.

context.evidence: The complete table title, opponent-AC axis, all seven attacker-level bands, and its applicable missile-range note are present together. The owner identifies this full named matrix lookup; no neighboring context is needed to distinguish the table.

highlight.evidence: Overlay focus 1 covers the complete lookup table including row/column labels and cells; focus 2 separately covers the complete missile adjustment. The whole-table emphasis matches this matrix owner, and no unrelated table is included.

default.evidence: The production-generated direct citation route opened this matrices owner at DMG p. 74 with region dmg-74-ia-cleric-druid-monk selected and its matching image loaded. This catalog has one applicable region; default-order hash is recorded.

reviewedOwners.title: Attack Matrix for Magic-Users and Illusionists

sourceContentObserved.table: I.C. ATTACK MATRIX FOR MAGIC-USERS AND ILLUSIONISTS; opponent AC −10 through 10, five attacker-level bands (1–5, 6–10, 11–15, 16–20, 21+), 105 numeric cells.
notes: Missiles: * −5 at long range, −2 at medium range.
sourceContentObserved.pixelFinding: The full table, missile adjustment and asterisk qualifier are visible. The asterisk qualifies the missile adjustment as normal, not magical; it does not qualify the entire matrix. The crop retains the physical page right edge; focus rectangles stay on the printed table and two notes.

crop.evidence: Inspected the current crop against DMG PDF p. 75 pixels. The entire I.C table and both note lines are visible, including the complete qualifier; right-side glyphs and page edge are preserved.

context.evidence: The full table title, axes, all five bands, missile adjustment, and its asterisk qualifier are presented together. The qualifier is correctly scoped to the missile adjustment, not the full matrix.

highlight.evidence: Overlay focus 1 covers the whole named table and all cells; focuses 2 and 3 separately cover the missile adjustment and its complete 'Normal, not magical' qualifier. No unrelated neighboring material is highlighted.

default.evidence: The production-generated direct citation route opened this matrices owner at DMG p. 74 with region dmg-74-ic-magic-user-illusionist selected and its matching image loaded. This catalog has one applicable region; default-order hash is recorded.

reviewedOwners.title: Attack Matrix for Thieves and Assassins

sourceContentObserved.table: I.D.1. ATTACK MATRIX FOR THIEVES AND ASSASSINS; opponent AC −10 through 10, six attacker-level bands 1–4a, 5–8b, 9–12c, 13–16d, 17–20d, 21+d, 126 numeric cells.
notes: Missiles: −5 at long range, −2 at medium range.
a. Thieves and assassins double damage from a surprise back stab.
b. Thieves and assassins triple damage from a surprise back stab.
c. Thieves and assassins quadruple damage from a surprise back stab.
d. Thieves and assassins quintuple damage from a surprise back stab.
sourceContentObserved.pixelFinding: The title, complete six-band table, missile adjustment, and all four complete backstab notes are visible. Focus includes the a marker at the left edge and the final table row, range note, and note lines without clipped glyphs or the unrelated page-edge artifact.

crop.evidence: Inspected the current crop against DMG PDF p. 75 pixels. The full I.D.1 table and all four backstab notes plus missile adjustment are present; the final row and note glyphs are not clipped.

context.evidence: The complete named table, all six printed band markers (a, b, c, d, d, d), missile adjustment, and the four matching a–d backstab definitions are shown together.

highlight.evidence: Overlay focus 1 covers the complete table; distinct focuses cover the full missile line and each a–d backstab note. The marker at the start of note a is inside the focus; no unrelated page-edge artifact is selected.

default.evidence: The production-generated direct citation route opened this matrices owner at DMG p. 74 with region dmg-74-id1-thief-assassin selected and its matching image loaded. This catalog has one applicable region; default-order hash is recorded.

references: DMG printed p. 74, I.A names clerics, druids and monks
sourceConflict.reviewStatement: The DMG I.A crop and owner are confirmed as the complete DMG table. This does not adjudicate the Monk table conflict or establish a DM's ruling.
